scope_rule: A finding is 'app-expressible' when a developer can commit the same defect in their own zkApp source. A finding is 'library-internal' when correct application code still hits the bug, so no pattern exists in app source to detect.

V-O1J-VUL-012.title: Asserting preconditions may overwrite previous assertions
V-O1J-VUL-012.pattern: two precondition assertions on the same property in one method; the second silently discards the first

V-O1J-VUL-030.title: Prover errors when calling set() on same contract
V-O1J-VUL-030.pattern: state get() after set() in the same method reads the pre-set value

V-O1J-VUL-060.title: Inverse assertion allows for common anti-pattern
V-O1J-VUL-060.pattern: div()/inv()/sqrt() inside a Provable.if branch; the assertion fires unconditionally

borderline.V-O1J-VUL-014: Struct/CircuitValue inheritance breaks the static check(). Expressible as `class B extends A` where A is a Struct, but the defect is in o1js's static dispatch, and it is Fixed.
borderline.V-O1J-VUL-018: Wrong setVerificationKey auth in o1js's own dummy/allImpossible presets. Adjacent to O1JS_WEAK_PERMISSIONS, but the bug is in the preset, not in app code.

notes: The 58 library-internal findings sit in gadgets/, o1js-bindings/, crypto/, foreign-field, group, int and merkle-map internals. A static analyzer of @method bodies cannot observe them; detecting those requires analyzing o1js itself, which is a different tool.
